meaning:
διά-φορος, -ον
(διαφέρω), [in LXX for שְׁנָא (Dan.7:7, 19); also as in Polyb., iv, 188, al., Τὸ δ., τὰ δ., money: Sir.27:1 42:5, 2Ma.3:6 ;]
1. different: Rom.12:6, Heb.9:10.
2. excellent: compar., -ώτερος, Heb.1:4 8:6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.
